name: overdrive
description: Overdrive, a PS5 game store. The scripts wrap the ps5-react build for this app.
//: JSON has no comments; npm ignores this key.
setup      Run once after cloning. Installs every dependency: the apt or Homebrew packages
for the preview, the PS5 build and the tests (asks for sudo on Linux), Pillow, and
the framework's npm packages. See packaging/setup.sh.
build      Builds the PS5 app, then packages Overdrive.exfat and update.zip here, like the
GitHub workflow. Needs LLVM 18, cmake, ninja, nasm, exfatprogs; asks for sudo
to mount the image while filling it. See packaging/build.sh.
build:app  The PS5 build only, into ps5-react/dist/PPSA99058. No sudo.
preview    Opens the app in the desktop preview window on this PC. No PS5 toolchain needed.
dev        Same window, rebuilt and restarted on every save under app/. State resets.
test       The framework's checks; run after changing rendering or input in ps5-react/.
CC=clang CXX=clang++: the preview is compiled with clang on every platform, since GCC
stops on a bounds warning in archive_preflight.cpp.

scripts.preview: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ python3 tools/cli.py preview --app-dir ../app
scripts.dev: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ python3 tools/cli.py preview --app-dir ../app --watch
scripts.test: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ npm test
